request: Run alchemy-orchestrate on this: the plan .alchemy/runs/r3/plan.json passed its plan check, and P1 and P2 are about to start in parallel. The pre-commit hook in .githooks/pre-commit scans for secrets and rewrites size-baseline.json and src/generated/ on every commit; neither package's write set holds those files. How do P1 and P2 commit their work, and who owns the files the hook rewrites?

expect.criterion: generated-outputs #1: commits and file ownership in a run are decided under the orchestration contract
generated-outputs #2: outputs a hook rewrites are declared generated in the profile, outside every package's write set
generated-outputs #3: implementers commit through the repository's hooks, never around them
generated-outputs #4: the integration owner regenerates the outputs on the integrated head instead of merging them
